segments.text: - Can review code, automate tasks, and build security tooling in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ruby, Java)

segments.under: You might be a good fit as an Infrastructure Engineer if you
segments.text: - Have experience with an assortment of common applications and protocols, such as Apache, MySQL, NFS, Squid, Redis, Docker, DHCP, SSH, DNS, LDAP, SMTP, etc.
- Deep hands-on experience with Java, Groovy, Spring Boot, OpenJDK, GraphQL, REST APIs, MySQL, and PostgreSQL
- Familiarity with containerized deployment environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
- Demonstrated proficiency writing and reviewing production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks.
- Experience with real-time stream processing and batch processing (using technologies such as Flink, Spark, Kafka, Druid)
- Experience with Matlab, Simulink, Python, Go, C++ and/or Linux systems
- Experience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database design
- Lambda development and deployment using the AWS CDK.
- Vous maitrisez les différents flux de données mis en oeuvre dans la solution ainsi que leur transformation, leur stockage et leur distribution dans un contexte Cloud (GCP et Azure)
- connaissance spécifique pointue des technologies cloud de Google (GCP), Microsoft (Azure) ou Amazon (AWS);
- Stack complète à la pointe de l’innovation : Python, Kubernetes, Kafka, Spark, Google Cloud Platform (BQ, Dataflow, Compute Engine, PubSub, AppEngine…) , Airflow, Docker
- Build, manage, and evolve IAC using Terraform, Helm and Go CRDs.
- Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, Go.
- Familiarity with avionics data buses and communication protocols (e.g., ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553, AFDX, CAN, SPI, UART, etc)
